notes.title: Help me shape School of Magic and win Steam keys
notes.content:
I’m working on a new Necromancer spell that summons skeletons to fight alongside you. While the mechanics are still in progress, I want to involve the community in the card design!

 🔹 How to participate: Use Adobe Firefly to generate fantasy-style card images and share your results with a link (see image instructions below).  

🔹 Example Prompt: [url=https://firefly.adobe.com/shared/texttoimage?id=urn:aaid:sc:EU:a99bdadf-4cb4-4288-a994-be9a69a896a6]Just go here and edit the prompt to your liking [/url]

🔹 Rewards:    
🏆 First Place – Your card design will be added to School of Magic,  and you’ll be credited in the game! And you will win a Steam game.    
🥈 Second Place – Wins a Steam game.  
🥉 Third Place – Wins a Steam game. 
 🎟 Raffle – Three additional participants (outside the top three) will    be randomly selected to win a Steam game!

 🔹 How to join? Write an email to niki@parttimeindie.com or post here in the steam forums and send the picture you want to submit and the adobe firefly link (see instructions below)

The winners will be announced on the 20. of March.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37031044/0092a467456e8df4c1e309542f38f8624ec8072b.png[/img]

notes.title: Your last chance to get into the beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38425364/f2a8f27bd37d33bfcf4b4c67da380f4699265111.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

I've got some exciting news about School of Magic! The open beta registration will be closing soon, and from then on, the next update will be for beta players only. If you haven't joined yet, now's your chance! The open beta registration will close on Monday, July 15th. To join the beta you need to join my discord server: https://discord.gg/YBXAPkZ

I've been working hard on the first boss, and I'm thrilled to announce that in the next few weeks, I'll be dropping a preview of the boss fight for you to try out. This is a huge milestone because it means I'm finally starting to push forward on content. I'm excited to create the skill tree with new cards and abilities, and explore new areas filled with fresh enemies (yes, even pirates!).

Your feedback on the boss fight will be super important to make sure it's as awesome as it can be. Don't miss out on this chance to be part of the development and get exclusive content.

Join the beta now, and let's make School of Magic amazing together!

Thanks for all your support and enthusiasm.

notes.title: Huge AI Update
notes.content:
Introducing the highly anticipated AI Update for "School of Magic"! Experience a whole new level of immersion with visually stunning enhancements, including revamped card art and fully voiced NPC interactions. Conquer new challenges with added elite enemies, save and load functionality during runs, and an overhauled metagame progression system. Enjoy various polish and performance improvements for a smoother gaming experience. Update your game now and embark on an unforgettable adventure filled with magic and wonder!

Changes:
[list]
[*] New Card Art (Adobe Firefly)
[*] Places now have 2D art instead of a different camera when interacting (Adobe Firefly) 
[*] NPCs now how a Picture as their avatar when interacting (Adobe Firefly)
[*] Complete rewrite of the narrative to be third person and higher quality (with help of Chat GPT)
[*] A voiced narrator (elevenlabs)
[*] New elite system 
[*] Saving during runs works now
[*] Reworked Dialogue System UI
[*] Improved Visuals
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Gamescom update part 2
notes.content:
The second part of the gamescom update is here and it should include all of the changes I wanted to do after hearing your opinions. Thanks again to anyone who played and gave feedback.
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Changed Font of standard texts to Faustina (thanks to Vincent Büker from Gamescom for picking the font)
[*] Increase scale of card hover for increased readability
[*] Tooltips of cards are now coming faster
[*] Mouse Cursor changes[list]
[*] new normal icon
[*] added icon for cooldown / out of Mana 
[*] added icon for interactions (NPCs, chests...)
[*] added icon for interaction, click[/list]
[*] Added Keywords[list]
[*] School of Magic (this replaces the tutorial message box from before)
[*] Shrine (To make shrines easier readable)[/list]
[*] When casting spells while they have cooldown, a sound will be played
[*] Summoned Minions no longer give loot bags, gold...
[*] Fixed some nav mesh problems
[*] Fixed bug that blocked WASD movement when moving over the level up icon
[*] Fixed bug that happens when game data file was empty
[*] Fixed teleporting bug
[*] Teleport makes you now invincible for 0.75 seconds
[*] The Camera does no longer lock you in place during combat, instead the area where you can walk will get blocked by rocks... that get "teleported" into
the level and create a fighting area. 
[*] Enemies now spawn when you are with them on screen
[*] Added spawn SFX and VFX for spawning enemies and fighting area blockers
[*] If a spell fails to cast, it will no longer cost you Mana or put it on cooldown
[*] Fixed Minor bug  inside the spell queue
[*] The Spell "Grow Through Pain" (Exp on hit) is replaced by "Painful Experience" (Crit Chance increase on hit)
[*] Projectiles that travel through enemies are now aiming more accurately
[*] Necromancers now cast their skeleton between you and them instead of behind you
[/list]

Next will be Minibosses and Save and Load during a run. 

Regards Niki

notes.title: Gamescom update part 1
notes.content:
At gamescom I got a bunch of feedback that I want to include into the game and this is the first batch of bugfixes / improvements from gamescom.

[list]
[*]     Fixed Bug that would make wasd not work on stop enemies from spawning
[*]     Added icons to map and mini map, to give you a better overview
[*]     Increased movement speed while out of combat
[*]     Level up now gives you full life
[*]     Cleaned interactions a little bit
[/list]

There are still a bunch of things missing including the removal of the locked camera during combat, because this is a bigger change I decided to first publish this update. The next one should come in the next couple of weeks. Thanks to anyone who came around, I had a great time.

notes.title: School of Magic will be at Games 2022
notes.content:
I am going to show School of Magic at this years gamescom and I am really excited. To celebrate I created a new Trailer and I am giving away [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/640890/Will_Glow_the_Wisp/?utm_source=SchoolOfMagicSteam&utm_campaign=wishlistevent&utm_medium=web]Will Glow the Wisp[/url] for free if enough people Wishlist School of Magic. 
Here is how the event works
[list]
[*] 10 000 wishlist for School of Magic means that the price for Will Glow the Wisp drops from 2.99$ to 1.99$
[*] 15 000 wishlist drops the price to 0.99$
[*] 20 000 wishlists for School of Magic makes Will Glow the Wisp free
[*] The price will change either by the end of the Gamescom (Aug 28th 23:00 CET) or after 20 000 wishlists have been hit. Keep in mind that Valve still needs to process the request so expect a slight delay, after the event is over. 
[/list]

So if you want to get Will Glow the Wisp for free go and Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106680/School_of_Magic/?utm_source=SteamWillGlowTheWisp&utm_campaign=wishlistevent&utm_medium=web]School of Magic[/url] and just wait 😉

notes.title: Bugfixes from Gamescom feedback
notes.content:
[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]
- If you open the potion dealer 2 times all potions are gone
- Madam Sasa lets you level spells
- German Translation for "Beuteltasche" should have oder instead of und
- Armor text fixed
- If you cast a spell and then click on an event, you can start the event from further away
- Endless hourglass can get triggered while in the menu (e.g. on level up), also sometimes doesn't reset
- Map gets moved when holding the mouse to move
- Ghost projectile doesn't level correctly
- Cards in the world overlay the map
- Sometimes the end of the level arrow appears too early (I tried to fix it, but because it only happens sometimes not sure if it is really fixed)
- If you press m or something in the first tutorial screen you can get the game to bug 
- Added VSync to low and very quality settings
- Sometimes cards don't get removed on level up
- Madam Sasa sometimes doesn't remove cards
- Some players do not see the first picks on startup during the tutorial 
[b]Open Issues[/b]
- Some areas are not walkable
- Teleport lets you sometimes teleport outside of the playfield
- Mana Reduction seems to be somewhat wrong
- Ultrawide monitors can have problems with the map (don't have those)
